digest: SPEC.md 대비 src/ 검토: S1·S2·S4·S5·S7·C2·T1·T2는 구현 근거가 있고, S3·S6·C1·T3(launchRetries 명칭)은 명세 위반 후보, Q1(단위 테스트 부재)은 미충족. 테스트는 실행하지 않음.

scopeLimitations.text: Read-only review; no tests were executed. testExecutionAttested is false.
Implementation judged by static reading of src/workflow-stop.ts, workflow-cancellation.ts, workflow-terminal.ts only; no runtime behavior observed.
store.js (readWorkflowStopIntent, readJson, workflowRunPath) is absent from src/, so its reject/throw semantics were not verified.
inspect-tests returned zero testMap entries; no upstream test-based coverage evidence was available. Glob found no test files by name in src/ or repo.

evidence.quote: const timer = setInterval(() => void check(), pollMs);

evidence.relevance: content text parsed once per level
recursion on strictly shorter nested text

candidateFindings.title: pollMs default and floor differ from spec
candidateFindings.claim: Default pollMs is 200 and the minimum clamp is 1, but the spec requires default 50ms and no value below 10ms.
specEvidence: SPEC.md line 13: 중지 감시 주기(`pollMs`)의 기본값은 50ms이고
testEvidence: No test files found in src/ or repo; no default or floor test exists.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Static reading only; behavior not executed.

candidateFindings.title: isWorkflowStopRequestedError also matches by message
candidateFindings.claim: The predicate accepts errors by message prefix, which the spec forbids; only the WorkflowStopRequested name may qualify.
specEvidence: SPEC.md line 18: isWorkflowStopRequestedError는 이름이 WorkflowStopRequested인 오류만 중지 오류로
SPEC.md line 19: 메시지 내용으로 판별해서는 안 된다.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Low; the clause is explicit in the code.

candidateFindings.title: Cancellation classifier accepts extra markers
candidateFindings.claim: Beyond aborted, AbortError and ABORT_ERR, the classifier treats cancelled and timeout strings and cancelled:true flags as cancellation, contrary to the exact-three rule.
specEvidence: SPEC.md line 25-26: 정확히 aborted, AbortError, ABORT_ERR 세 가지만 취소로 인정한다. 다른 provider 오류를 취소로 승격해서는 안 된다.
testEvidence: No test files exist to check the rejected-marker cases.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Code comment states intent to be exact; whether the extra markers are deliberate for provider compatibility is a product question.

candidateFindings.title: Public launch retry field is named launchRetries
candidateFindings.claim: The summary exposes launchRetries instead of the public contract name launchRetryAttempts; the sum logic itself matches the spec.
specEvidence: SPEC.md line 35-36: outputRetryAttempts와 launchRetryAttempts ... 이 두 필드 이름은 공개 계약이다(외부 도구가 읽는다).
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Whether external consumers already read launchRetries should be confirmed; the spec is explicit that the name is public.

candidateFindings.title: No unit tests for S, C, T items
candidateFindings.claim: The spec requires a unit test per S/C/T item, but no test files exist in src/ or the repository.
specEvidence: SPEC.md line 40: 위 S·C·T 항목마다 그 동작을 확인하는 단위 테스트가 있어야 한다.
implementationEvidence: Glob src/**/* returns only workflow-cancellation.ts, workflow-stop.ts, workflow-terminal.ts.
testEvidence: Glob for *.test.* and *.spec.* in src/ and repo returned no files.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Tests could use a naming convention not covered by the glob (for example __tests__ or *_test.*).

noIssueNotes: S2 error name and message format match the spec (src/workflow-stop.ts:44, :49).
S5 dispose clears the only interval, so no further reads start from ticks (src/workflow-stop.ts:81, :85).
S7 unregister removes the signal and deletes the empty run entry (src/workflow-stop.ts:17-20).
C2 recursion terminates because each level parses a strictly shorter nested string; the identity guard at :28 is effectively dead code.
T1 and T2 match the spec on inspection; for T2 incomplete tasks take precedence over an unreadable control.json, which the spec does not address.
